cohort: 151 patients aged 18-45 who underwent cervical cerclage at Zeynep Kamil Hospital between 2014 and 2021.
finding: Gestational age at delivery was inversely correlated with BMI, with the obese group having a significantly lower gestational age at delivery and fewer deliveries at ≥37 weeks compared to the normal and overweight groups.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at cervical cerclage: 18.0 ± 4.0 weeks, median gestational age at delivery: 37.0 weeks
